metaDescription: JK 024 sweet potato is a sweet potato variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: JK 024 is a registered sweet potato variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2003 as NSIC 2003 Sp 26. Its record notes 14.62 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about JK 024 sweet potato
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

Its average yield of 14.62 t/ha trails the average of its group, 15.15. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in trials, rated under natural field conditions
rows: Took some damage but held up

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit sweet potato fields most often: [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its roots have white flesh and white skin. Dry matter is 34.07 percent. A higher dry matter cooks mealy and gives processors more flour or starch from each tonne. The starch content is 15.94 percent.
Where and when to plant JK 024 sweet potato
Pick by use and market: yellow or orange flesh for snacks and fries, purple for processing, white for boiling. Weevils are the main enemy, so plant clean cuttings and harvest on time.
